package.name: hex_gr80_description
package.description: URDF description of the GR80 lobster-claw gripper (end-effector, ROBOT_KIND_EE). TRIAL export (0.0.1): articulated jaws via mimic joints (driver jaw_joint1, 0=closed), gear follower, tcp frame; placeholder inertials and full-res collision meshes — all to be replaced by the formal CAD export. See robot-overall-design 11-ee-api §9.
